accommodation.name: Onefam Batlló
accommodation.receptionHours: Limited reception between 12:00 am and 8:00 am
accommodation.ageRecommendation: 18-45 years (social, party-oriented hostel for travelers who want to meet new people and enjoy nightlife)
accommodation.cancellationPolicy: Changes or cancellations must be made at least 2 full days before arrival by emailing to avoid late cancellation fee. Non-refundable bookings not entitled to refund.
accommodation.facilities: Mixed dorms and private rooms available
accommodation.discount: 10% discount on next stay using code ONEFAMDIRECT when booking directly on website
accommodation.notes: Hostel located on famous Modernist avenue, walking distance from Casa Batlló and Casa Milà. Social atmosphere designed for young travelers.

arrival.notes: Long-haul overnight flight from Buenos Aires. Arrive early morning. Airport transport options: R2 Nord train (4.90 EUR, 26 mins to Passeig de Gràcia), Metro L9 Sud (5.90 EUR), Aerobús (7.45 EUR), or taxi (30-40 EUR).

departure.notes: Early morning departure. Metro and trains start at 05:00 on weekdays. R2 Nord from Passeig de Gràcia or Metro L9 Sud are viable at 06:15. Allow 2 hours before departure.

days.title: Arrival Day & Historic Heart (Ciutat Vella, Gótico & El Born)

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Arrival from Buenos Aires. Check-in at hostel (if available) or store luggage. Start exploring La Rambla and Barrio Gótico.

activities.name: Airport Arrival & Transport to City
activities.notes: Take Renfe R2 Nord train (4.90 EUR, 26 mins to Passeig de Gràcia) or Metro L9 Sud (5.90 EUR). Early morning arrival means early check-in may not be available.

activities.name: Onefam Batlló Check-in / Luggage Storage
activities.timeRestriction: Check-in typically 14:00-15:00, early luggage storage usually available
activities.notes: Store luggage if room not ready. Freshen up and have breakfast if included.

activities.name: La Rambla
activities.notes: Iconic tree-lined pedestrian boulevard. See flower stalls, street performers, and Fuente de Canaletes. Watch for pickpockets.

secondaryPlaces.name: Fuente de Canaletes
secondaryPlaces.notes: Legend says drinking from this fountain means you'll return to Barcelona

activities.name: Mercat de la Boqueria
activities.notes: Famous covered market on La Rambla. Front stalls are touristy; venture deeper for authentic produce, jamón, and fresh juice stands.

activities.name: Barrio Gótico Walking Exploration
activities.notes: Medieval Gothic Quarter with narrow winding streets, hidden plazas, and Roman walls. Get intentionally lost.

activities.name: Catedral de Barcelona
activities.notes: Gothic cathedral with beautiful cloister and rooftop views (9 EUR extra). Free entry for worship; donation suggested.

secondaryPlaces.name: Pont del Bisbe
secondaryPlaces.notes: Neo-Gothic bridge with skull detail nearby

secondaryPlaces.name: Plaça de Sant Felip Neri
secondaryPlaces.notes: Quiet hidden square with tragic Civil War history

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Menú del día at authentic local restaurant in Barrio Gótico or El Born.

activities.name: Lunch - Menú del Día
activities.notes: Find authentic spot with menú del día (15-25 EUR). Order pa amb tomàquet as starter. Avoid touristy laminated multilingual menus on La Rambla.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Explore El Born & La Ribera. Visit Santa Maria del Mar and walk through Parc de la Ciutadella.

activities.name: El Born & La Ribera Neighborhood
activities.notes: Trendy medieval neighborhood with artisan shops, galleries, and tapas bars. More authentic than La Rambla.

activities.name: Santa Maria del Mar
activities.notes: Stunning 14th-century Catalan Gothic church. Free entry for worship, 10 EUR for guided tour. Famous for pure Gothic architecture.

activities.name: Museu Picasso
activities.notes: Picasso's early works and Blue Period collection. Book online to skip lines. Optional if tired from overnight flight.
activities.cost: 12 EUR general, extra for temporary exhibitions

activities.name: Parc de la Ciutadella
activities.notes: Large central park with lake, fountain, and greenery. Good for relaxing after museum or long walk.

secondaryPlaces.name: Cascada Monumental
secondaryPlaces.notes: Ornate fountain designed partly by young Gaudí

activities.name: Arc de Triomf
activities.notes: Red brick triumphal arch built for 1888 World's Fair. Great photo spot at entrance to park.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Experience la hora del vermut before returning to hostel for included dinner.

activities.name: La Hora del Vermut
activities.notes: Traditional Catalan aperitif ritual. Order vermut de grifo (on tap) with olives, chips, and anchovies. Use Entrespacios restaurant map for authentic spots.

alternatives.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Moved to Day 2 for better pacing on arrival day after overnight flight

research_notes.notes: Day 1 intentionally lighter due to overnight flight from Buenos Aires. Focused on walkable historic center. Museu Picasso marked optional if jetlag is strong.

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Walk Passeig de Gràcia to see Manzana de la Discordia modernist houses and visit Casa Batlló or La Pedrera.

activities.name: Manzana de la Discordia
activities.notes: Block of Discord - three competing Modernist buildings (Casa Batlló, Casa Amatller, Casa Lleó Morera). Just 2 blocks from your hostel. Free exterior viewing.

activities.name: Casa Batlló
activities.notes: Gaudí's organic sea-inspired house. Book online in advance for cheaper tickets and specific time slot. Audio guide included.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book 1-3 days ahead, often sells out

activities.name: Casa Amatller
activities.notes: Neo-Gothic modernist house by Puig i Cadafalch. Alternative to Casa Batlló if budget-conscious. Chocolate museum inside.

activities.name: Passeig de Gràcia Walk
activities.notes: Barcelona's most elegant boulevard. Walk 15 blocks from Manzana up to La Pedrera. Designer shops, cafés, modernist streetlamps by Gaudí.

activities.name: La Pedrera (Casa Milà)
activities.notes: Gaudí's wave-like apartment building with surreal rooftop. Book online for time slot. Rooftop is iconic photo spot. Choose this OR Casa Batlló if budget/time limited.

timeBlocks.budget: 0-60 EUR (free walk, or 25-35 EUR for one house interior)

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Menú del día at Mercat del Ninot or local bistro in Esquerra Eixample. Try botifarra amb mongetes or fricandó.

activities.name: Mercat del Ninot
activities.notes: Renovated neighborhood market in Eixample with fresh produce and tapas bars inside. Good for quick bites or full lunch.

activities.name: Lunch - Catalan Classics
activities.notes: Order botifarra amb mongetes (sausage with white beans) or fricandó (veal stew). Menú del día 15-25 EUR. Use Entrespacios restaurant map.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Visit La Sagrada Família (book ahead!). Optional: Hospital de Sant Pau.

activities.name: La Sagrada Família
activities.notes: Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece. MUST book specific time slot online days/weeks ahead - often sells out. Allow 1.5-2 hours. Consider tower access (+10 EUR).

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book 1-4 weeks ahead, especially in high season

activities.name: Hospital de Sant Pau
activities.notes: Modernist hospital complex by Domènech i Montaner. 10-min walk from Sagrada Família. Beautiful but optional if tired.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Stroll elegant Eixample streets before returning to hostel for dinner.

activities.name: Eixample Neighborhood Evening Walk
activities.notes: Walk grid-pattern streets back toward hostel. Admire chamfered corners (xamfrans) and modernist details on residential buildings.

alternatives.name: Casa Lleó Morera
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Less visited than Casa Batlló or Casa Amatller; exterior view sufficient

alternatives.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would require booking guided tour; prioritized Gaudí sites for Day 2

research_notes.notes: Day 2 is Gaudí/Modernism heavy. Sagrada Família booking is CRITICAL - often sold out. Budget consideration: choose ONE paid house (Casa Batlló OR La Pedrera) if needed.

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Explore Gràcia neighborhood - independent village vibe with plazas and local markets.

activities.name: Gràcia Neighborhood Walk
activities.notes: Former independent village absorbed by Barcelona. Bohemian atmosphere, local shops, squares with outdoor terraces. More authentic than touristy areas.

activities.name: Plaça de la Virreina
activities.notes: Charming square with church bell tower and outdoor cafés. Heart of Gràcia.

activities.name: Plaça del Sol
activities.notes: Sun Square - popular spot for locals, especially evenings. Good for morning coffee stop.

activities.name: Mercat de la Llibertat
activities.notes: Modernist neighborhood market in Gràcia. Less touristy than La Boqueria. Good for snacks or picnic supplies.

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Seafood lunch - order suquet de peix or arròs negre. Avoid tourist trap 'paella in 15 minutes'.

activities.name: Lunch - Seafood Specialties
activities.notes: Order suquet de peix (fish stew) or arròs negre (black rice with squid ink). AVOID places advertising 'paella ready in 15 minutes' - authentic rice dishes take 20-30 mins minimum. Use Entrespacios map.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Beach time at Bogatell or Mar Bella (skip crowded Barceloneta). Alternative: Montjuïc hill.

activities.name: Bogatell Beach
activities.notes: Sandy beach north of Port Olímpic. Less crowded and touristy than Barceloneta. Good for swimming, sunbathing, or beach walk. Take Metro L4 to Ciutadella Vila Olímpica.

activities.name: Mar Bella Beach
activities.notes: Even quieter beach further north. Alternative to Bogatell. Partial nudist section. Take Metro L4 to Selva de Mar.

activities.name: Montjuïc Hill
activities.notes: Alternative to beach. Large hill with gardens, museums, Olympic sites, and castle. Take cable car or bus 150 from Plaça Espanya. Good if weather is bad or prefer culture over beach.

secondaryPlaces.name: Jardins de Mossèn Costa i Llobera

activities.name: Castell de Montjuïc
activities.notes: 18th-century fortress at top of Montjuïc with panoramic city views. If choosing Montjuïc over beach.

timeBlocks.budget: 0-5 EUR (free beach, or 5 EUR castle if Montjuïc)

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Final night aperitif - toast with cava and escalivada before hostel dinner.

activities.name: Evening Aperitif - Cava & Tapas
activities.notes: Final evening in Barcelona. Order glass of local cava (sparkling wine) and escalivada (roasted vegetables). Celebrate last night before Paris departure tomorrow.

timeBlocks.name: night
timeBlocks.description: Optional: Magic Fountain of Montjuïc light and music show.

activities.name: Font Màgica de Montjuïc (Magic Fountain Show)
activities.timeRestriction: Thu-Sun evenings, times vary by season (typically 21:00-22:00 Oct)
activities.notes: Free choreographed water, light, and music show at Plaça Espanya. Schedule changes by season - check official website. About 20-min show. Get there early for good spot.

alternatives.name: Barceloneta Beach
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Very crowded and touristy according to Entrespacios guide; Bogatell recommended instead

alternatives.name: Park Güell
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would require advance booking and take full morning; already have 2 Gaudí sites on Day 2

research_notes.notes: Day 3 offers flexibility: beach OR Montjuïc depending on weather/preference. Magic Fountain is optional night activity if energy permits before early departure tomorrow.

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Early departure to airport for 08:45 flight to Paris Orly.

activities.name: Wake Up & Check Out
activities.notes: Pack and check out. Breakfast may not be available due to early departure - check with hostel or pack snacks night before.

activities.name: Transport to Barcelona Airport
activities.timeRestriction: Metro starts 05:00, R2 Nord first train ~05:50 from Passeig de Gràcia
activities.notes: Options: (1) R2 Nord train from Passeig de Gràcia (4.90 EUR, 19 mins to airport T2, first train ~05:50), (2) Metro L9 Sud (5.90 EUR, starts 05:00), (3) Taxi/Cabify (30-40 EUR, most reliable for early morning). Arrive airport by 06:45-07:00 (2 hours before 08:45 flight).

activities.name: Flight to Paris Orly
activities.notes: Vueling flight BCN → ORY. Flight time ~1h45. Arrive Paris Orly mid-morning.

alternatives.name: Aerobús early morning
alternatives.reason_not_selected: More expensive (7.45 EUR) and slower (35-40 mins) than train; but is 24/7 option

research_notes.notes: Departure day is purely logistics. R2 Nord train timing confirmed - first departure from Passeig de Gràcia to airport around 05:50. Taxi is backup if train timing is tight.

must_try_dishes.name_english: Pan con tomate / Bread with tomato
must_try_dishes.description: Toasted bread rubbed with ripe tomato, drizzled with olive oil and salt. Catalan staple, served as side or starter.
Flame-roasted spring onions dipped in rich romesco (nut and pepper) sauce. Eaten with hands.
Slow-roasted smoky Mediterranean vegetables (eggplant, peppers, onions) with olive oil.
Traditional winter soup with pasta, vegetables, and boiled meat. Two-course dish.
Roasted meat-filled pasta tubes topped with bechamel and baked. Traditional for Sant Esteve (Dec 26).
Grilled local pork sausage served with sautéed white beans. Classic Catalan comfort food.
Tender veal stewed with wild mushrooms (moixernons) in savory sauce.
Traditional veal tripe and trotters stewed with chickpeas. Hearty winter dish.
Coastal fish and potato stew with sofrito (tomato, garlic, onion) base. Simple and flavorful.
Rice cooked with squid ink, giving it black color and briny flavor. Served with alioli.
Historic medieval custard dessert with caramelized sugar crust. Catalonia's answer to crème brûlée.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Midday aperitif ritual (12:00-14:00 or 18:00-20:00). Vermut de grifo (on tap) served with olives, chips, anchovies, and cheese. Social tradition.
Local sparkling wine made in traditional method, primarily from Penedès region near Barcelona.
drinks_and_rituals.typical_cost: 4-8 EUR per glass, 15-30 EUR per bottle

drinks_and_rituals.description: Red wine mixed with lemon soda (not Sprite). Refreshing summer drink, less sweet than sangria.

restaurants.name: Entrespacios Curated Restaurant Map
restaurants.notes: Official Entrespacios map with 20+ vetted historic bars and restaurants across Barcelona neighborhoods. Use this as primary restaurant guide.

special_meal_formats.name_english: Menu of the day / Fixed-price lunch
special_meal_formats.description: Weekday lunch special (13:00-16:00) including starter, main, dessert, drink, and bread/coffee. Best value for authentic meal.
special_meal_formats.notes: Quality varies. Look for handwritten chalkboard menus and local clientele.

tourist_traps_to_avoid: Waiters aggressively calling you in from the street
Photos of dishes on the menu with prices like 'Paella + sangria 9,90 €'
Any restaurant advertising 'paella ready in 15 minutes' (authentic rice dishes need 20-30 mins minimum)
Restaurants directly on La Rambla (overpriced and low quality - venture one block off)

from_airport_to_city.duration: 19 mins to Sants, 26 mins to Passeig de Gràcia
from_airport_to_city.notes: Most convenient for Passeig de Gràcia area. Take free shuttle from T1 to T2 if needed.

from_airport_to_city.cost: 5.90 EUR (special airport ticket, not valid with T-Casual)
from_airport_to_city.duration: ~32 mins to Zona Universitària, then transfer
from_airport_to_city.notes: Requires transfer at Zona Universitària to reach city center. Less direct than train.
Most expensive but runs 24/7. Good backup option.
No Uber in Barcelona. Most reliable for early morning departures. Fixed airport rate.

ticket_types.name: T-Casual
ticket_types.notes: Best option for 3-4 days. Requires 1 EUR T-mobilitat reusable card.

ticket_types.name: T-Familiar
ticket_types.notes: Can be shared by multiple people traveling together.

ticket_types.name: Billete sencillo
ticket_types.notes: Single trip ticket. Not economical for multiple trips.

ticket_types.name: Hola Barcelona Travel Card
ticket_types.cost: 17.50 EUR (2 days), 24.50 EUR (3 days), 32 EUR (4 days), 39.50 EUR (5 days)
ticket_types.notes: Unlimited travel pass for tourists. May not be economical if staying near attractions.

physical.location: Ticket vending machines in any metro station
physical.card_required: 1 EUR T-mobilitat reusable card (one-time purchase, then recharge)

digital.notes: Can purchase and manage tickets digitally on smartphone. Contactless validation.

public_transport.notes: For 4 days (Oct 14-17), T-Casual (10 trips for 11.35 EUR) is most economical. Zone 1 covers all central Barcelona attractions.

bicing_official.notes: Bicing (official city bike-share) is ONLY for residents with annual subscription and Spanish NIE/ID number. NOT available for tourists.

tourist_alternatives.name: Donkey Republic
tourist_alternatives.notes: Unlock via app, leave anywhere within service area.

tourist_alternatives.name: Cooltra
tourist_alternatives.notes: Good for longer distances, requires license and helmet.

tourist_alternatives.name: Traditional bike rental shops
tourist_alternatives.locations: Throughout city, especially near beaches and Ciutadella park
tourist_alternatives.notes: In-person rental, more personal service, guided tours available.

tourist_assistance.description: Barcelona tourist information and assistance hotline

consulates.notes: For citizens of other countries, contact your embassy/consulate in Barcelona or Madrid if needed.

practical_tips: Pickpockets are common on La Rambla, metro, and crowded tourist areas. Keep valuables secure.
Most restaurants close 16:00-20:00 between lunch and dinner. Menú del día only available 13:00-16:00.
Tap water is safe to drink. Ask for 'agua del grifo' (free tap water) instead of bottled.
October weather: 15-22°C (59-72°F). Bring light layers and check forecast for beach day.
Siesta: Some smaller shops close 14:00-17:00. Major attractions stay open.
Book Sagrada Família online days/weeks ahead - it sells out!
Catalan is primary language, but Spanish widely spoken. English common in tourist areas.
Tipping: Not mandatory. Round up or leave 5-10% for good service.
Late dining culture: Locals eat dinner 21:00-23:00, but restaurants open earlier for tourists.

markets.name: Mercat de la Llibertat
markets.highlights: Modernist architecture, local neighborhood feel, covered

markets.name: Mercat del Ninot
markets.highlights: Recently renovated, tapas bars, central location near hostel

markets.name: Mercat de Lesseps
markets.highlights: Small neighborhood market in upper Gràcia

markets.name: La Boquería (Mercat de Sant Josep)
markets.warning: Front stalls overpriced and touristy; venture deeper for authentic vendors

curated_restaurants.notes: Use this map as primary restaurant reference. All vetted for authenticity and local quality.

attractions_by_day.day_1: 0-12 EUR (free walks, optional Museu Picasso 12 EUR)
attractions_by_day.day_2: 26-86 EUR (Sagrada Família 26 EUR required, Casa Batlló 35 EUR or La Pedrera 25 EUR optional)
attractions_by_day.day_3: 0-5 EUR (free beach/Gràcia, or Castell 5 EUR if Montjuïc)

transport.airport_departure: 4.90-5.90 EUR (train/metro) or 30-40 EUR (taxi recommended for early flight)

budget_summary.notes: Range depends on: (1) choosing paid Gaudí attractions (Casa Batlló, La Pedrera) vs free exterior viewing, (2) taxi vs public transport for departure, (3) daily food/drink spending. Minimum budget assumes skipping paid attractions and public transport only.

sources.name: Entrespacios Barcelona - Barrios y Playas (Neighborhoods & Beaches)
Entrespacios Barcelona - Qué ver (What to See)

alternatives_considered.name: Park Güell
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Requires advance booking (10 EUR), located far from city center, would consume full morning. Already have Sagrada Família and Casa Batlló/La Pedrera as Gaudí highlights.

alternatives_considered.name: Montserrat Day Trip
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Only 4 days total in Barcelona with early departure Day 4. Montserrat requires full day (2-3 hours each way). Not enough time.

alternatives_considered.name: Camp Nou Stadium Tour
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: User showed no interest in football/sports. Prioritized architecture, food culture, and authentic neighborhoods.

alternatives_considered.name: Barceloneta Beach
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Entrespacios guide explicitly warns it's overcrowded and very touristy. Bogatell and Mar Bella beaches recommended instead as quieter alternatives.

research_notes.notes: Itinerary designed for 4-day stay (Oct 14-17, 2026) with: (1) Early arrival Day 1 (05:25 from Buenos Aires), intentionally lighter day due to jetlag, (2) Full Modernism/Gaudí day on Day 2 with emphasis on advance booking Sagrada Família, (3) Neighborhood/beach culture Day 3, (4) Early departure Day 4 to Paris (08:45). Accommodation provides breakfast and dinner, so lunch is main meal planning focus. Emphasizes authentic local experiences over tourist traps per Entrespacios guidance and user's trip-itinerary-generator skill preferences.
